about: Lists of providers found for the Bridgeport (Potential) office, 613 Heron Drive, Bridgeport NJ 08014 (Logan Township, Gloucester County), by the publisher playbook of resource-discovery-design.md 6.1, on 13 October 2026. Home area: New Jersey statewide and Gloucester, Salem and Camden counties. Across the river: Pennsylvania (Delaware County and all of Philadelphia) and Delaware (New Castle County); every list carries its coverage. Lists only: no providers were harvested or checked, and no office-fit rules applied. namesFound is a rough count of providers a list names for the place, given only where the page text showed it. Where curl returned 403 or 404 the list is marked refused or dead, and the note says what was known only from search results. Many county lists carry their own residency limits; see each list's residency field.

gaps.clothing-household: Thin for the home area. No county furniture or mattress programme list for Gloucester or Salem; clothing appears only as single provider pages (a clothes closet at Newington Baptist, Catholic Charities thrift stores) and through 211. Rutgers links donations and clothing lists.
gaps.id-recovery: Only state-level rules (MVC; fee waivers for homeless people through a social worker; Smart Book first section). No county list of ID help or document clinics for Gloucester, Salem or Camden; Philadelphia's city resource guide and the Delco homeless coalition's guide cover IDs on the PA side.
gaps.reentry-support: Gloucester has a 2022 Smart Book and fair flyers but no current reentry directory; Camden's federal directory (2019) is dead; Salem has only jail programme pages. Statewide, the NJ Reentry Corporation directory (403 to curl) is the main list.
gaps.disability: County disability pages and Salem's 2024 Disability Resource Guide only; state disability directory read in summary.
gaps.children-pregnancy: Few lists: Family Success Centers appear only via 211; WIC sites are a county directory category (not opened); Camden ResourceNet is youth-focused.
gaps.education: Two single-provider pages (RCSJ, Literacy New Jersey) and a court GED list that is dead; no county adult-education directory.
gaps.immigration: Only national directories (ImmigrationLawHelp) and single-provider results; no county or regional immigrant services guide found for Gloucester or Salem. Camden Library has an immigrant-resources subject guide (not opened).
gaps.veterans: State VSO list and county office pages; the county-hosted NJ Military and Veterans Families Resource Guide was referred to but not opened.
gaps.transportation: Good for Gloucester (county Transit Guide, October 2026), Salem (SCOOT), and the Pureland shuttles; Camden has a senior transportation sub-page only. Nothing crosses the Delaware River bridges (DRPA: vehicular lanes only).
gaps.housing: Housing authority waiting lists exist only on aggregator pages, with conflicting dates. The Salem IAC housing guide (July 2025) and Delaware County coalition guide (Sept 2026 menu) are the best lists.
gaps.food: Rich: Rutgers Cooperative Extension county guides (Oct 2025), the Gloucester County directory (54 pantries) and Salem's county list. Hours and town-residency limits change often; the Food Bank of South Jersey's own map was refused to automated reading.
gaps.across-river: Pennsylvania and Delaware lists are fewer: Delaware County PA has good county pages; Philadelphia is a list of city programmes; the Delaware state sites reject automated reading, so those lists were seen only in search summaries.
